scope: Advanced/retarded Green and Cauchy-boundary structure of K1336--K1337's free Hilbert-valued normally hyperbolic control.

green_system.global_hyperbolicity: R x T3 with ultrastatic metric is globally hyperbolic and every t=constant slice is Cauchy
green_system.retarded_advanced: unique E_plus and E_minus on compactly supported smooth H_ps-valued sources
green_system.support: supp(E_plus f) subset J_plus(supp f) and supp(E_minus f) subset J_minus(supp f)
green_system.green_identity: Omega_Sigma is independent of the Cauchy slice for homogeneous solutions

claim_ceiling: The free tensor control is Green-hyperbolic and carries the standard conserved Cauchy symplectic form. This is not the source-owned GU BFV boundary law and does not establish an interacting Green system.
